findings.title: No documented search data-flow / retention statement
findings.note: No search module; privacy statement for query logs is absent.
findings.recommendation: Document that search is in-database and tenant-scoped, or add a search design doc if one is introduced.

report:
Not applicable / future readiness: there is
no dedicated search index or external search backend. Message search, where
present, is a PostgREST query over tenant-scoped tables; no indexing of PII to
a third party was found.
